This document guides AI agents on go-mapi. Read [README.md](README.md) and [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).

**Stack:** C++ (MinGW), Go, TypeScript + React. Pipeline: Windows App → [C++ DLL] → JSON files → [Go Native Host] → [Browser Extension] → Gmail API. Local-first, privacy-focused, offline-capable; external calls only when necessary. Prefer free services. Ship pragmatically. Use TypeScript strict mode and Go safety.

Keep related code together; minimize file splitting/bloat; colocate code. Use React Bootstrap, Radix UI, or similar. **Avoid utility-first CSS: No Tailwind. Prefer semantic, maintainable markup.** The project should be ready for translations from the start. Use message catalogs or i18n libraries for user-facing strings. Technical documentation remains in English.

**Build:** `npm run build` (or individual `npm run build:interceptor|native-host|extension`)  
**Test:** `npm run test`

### Interceptor (`src/interceptor/`)
Purpose: Capture MAPI calls and write JSON files to `%TEMP%\go-mapi\`. Target Simple MAPI spec only (not Extended MAPI/COM). Zero external dependencies (no nlohmann/json - hand-rolled JSON). Non-blocking - return immediately to caller. Thread-safe - multiple apps may call simultaneously. Test with debug build: `npm run build:interceptor:debug`; test Explorer, PDF viewers, etc.; check memory leaks and thread safety. `main.cpp` DLL entry point/exports; `mapi_impl.cpp` MAPISendMail; `json_writer.cpp` serialization; `fs_utils.cpp` filesystem.

### Native Host (`src/native-host/`)
Purpose: Bridge filesystem to browser extension via Chrome Native Messaging. Protocol (length-prefixed JSON):
`{"type": "email", "id": "...", "data": {...}}`
`{"type": "removed", "id": "..."}`
`{"type": "ready", "version": "1.0.0"}`
`{"type": "process", "id": "..."}`
`{"type": "delete", "id": "..."}`
`main.go` entry/message loop; `protocol.go`; `watcher.go` uses fsnotify. Run `gofmt` before committing. Test native messaging with the extension. Handle filesystem edge cases (deleted files, permission errors).

### Extension (`src/extension/`)
React 18, React Bootstrap, Vite, TypeScript; Chrome Identity API for OAuth. `manifest.json` Manifest v3; `src/background/service-worker.ts` native messaging + Gmail API; `src/popup/App.tsx`; `src/types/messages.ts`. Use React Bootstrap components for UI. Keep service worker minimal - offload to popup when possible. TypeScript strict mode is required. Test in both Chrome and Edge.

JSON files: `%TEMP%\go-mapi\*.json`; schema: [docs/json-schema.json](docs/json-schema.json). Fields include `"subject"`, `"body"`, `"bodyFormat": "plain|html"`, `"to"`, attachments (`"filename"`, `"path"`, `"size"`), and `"originApp"`.

Comment the "why", not the "what". Document non-obvious constraints; keep comments concise. Docs: README user-focused; CONTRIBUTING developer-focused; AGENTS AI-focused; ROADMAP strategic.

Use Conventional Commits: `feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `test:`, `refactor:`, `chore:`.

Workflow: understand component; read relevant source; check/run tests; identify related files. Follow patterns; keep changes minimal/focused; add tests; update docs when behavior changes. Run `npm run build`, `npm run test`, and manual tests for user-facing changes.

Personas: C++ Specialist (`src/interceptor/`): minimal, non-blocking, no dependencies. Go Developer (`src/native-host/`): filesystem watching/native messaging. Frontend Developer (`src/extension/`): React/Gmail. DevOps/CI (`.github/workflows/`): Windows builds.

Schema change: update `docs/json-schema.json`, C++ `json_writer.cpp`, TypeScript types in `src/extension/src/types/`, and Go structs in `src/native-host/`. Settings: add Chrome storage setting, UI, service-worker read, persist with `chrome.storage.sync`.

Release verification: `npm run build`; `npm run register:mapi` (admin); load extension in Chrome/Edge developer mode; inspect `%TEMP%\go-mapi\`; check extension DevTools. Use MinGW, React Bootstrap, and JSON files in `%TEMP%` as project decisions.
